notes.title: Cyber Courier 2088 Demo
notes.content:
Cyber Courier 2088 Demo Released !!

This is a "[b]Early Alpha Demo[/b] " 

The goal is to get feedback and to hear your suggestions !

Even at this early stage of development feedback is essential

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483040/5a57163d00299c8ee53b35c5020ee57975c58dd2.png[/img]

Recently made improvements to progression, so starting a [b]new game[/b] might be a good idea.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43483040/b02f4a9c2629dbdf294a925f14894404b33392f7.png[/img]

[b]Updates:[/b]
- Clean up city to unlock package delivery
- There is a find the cat mission 
- Some small visual updates
- The Hover Bike can only transport packages now 
- Slight improvement to bounty scanning 


Delivery some packages and passengers [b]join the Discord[/b] and tell me what you think !

Regards

WarpedDev
